notes:
Passed on the fake backend by python3 -m mhs.driver check (evidence contract_checked, never an MHS-Device level). Model-authored and unreviewed; no hardware or simulator run is claimed. The card entry symbol was confirmed at source/basic_locomotion_isaaclab/basic_locomotion_isaaclab/tasks/locomotion/locomotion_env.py:55; the driver serves Locomotion-Go2-Flat, registered at source/basic_locomotion_isaaclab/basic_locomotion_isaaclab/tasks/locomotion/__init__.py:57-65. DEVIATION FROM THE CARD mock path: mock_strategy.preferred is upstream-sim, but the task needs Isaac Sim, Isaac Lab, a GPU and an environment configuration object passed to gym.make (scripts/rsl_rl/train.py:51 and :174), and package code never imports or runs the clone; the fake is the package's own pure Python interface stand-in (fake.py), not the upstream simulator, and the sim path was not run. The fake models the contract, not the physics: one environment with the default 12-value action (go2_env_cfg.py:172) and a 260-value policy observation (52 values per frame at go2_env_cfg.py:173-183 times 5 history frames at :185-191). The upstream config batches 4096 environments (go2_env_cfg.py:337) and LocomotionEnv returns a dict of common, critic and policy groups (locomotion_env.py:423-455); the fake represents only the flat policy-sized Box, and every value except the last-action tail of the newest frame is a fixed placeholder (marked # placeholder), as is the reward. The fake never terminates or truncates; the episode time limit and the contact-based termination (locomotion_env.py:571-577) are not modelled. The action space is unbounded because the real action-space object is built by the external DirectRLEnv and was not inspected; the clone clamps to +/-3.0 inside _pre_physics_step (locomotion_env.py:322-323 with go2_env_cfg.py:388), but that is not published as a rejection limit, so G8.SAFE014_NOT_APPLICABLE reports CL2 instead of CL3 and no limit is invented. Expected warnings: G6.NO_NATIVE_CALL for cap.world.seed.v1 (the seed only sets the next reset), G7.MAYBE_ABSENT x5 (action_space, observation_space, reset, step and close are the Gymnasium interface from the external DirectRLEnv base), G8.SAFE014_NOT_APPLICABLE and four G8.NO_UNIT (ticks, both seed inputs, action.values). No G4.REF_VALUE or G4.REF_BINARY warning. Only catalogue classes are used, so there are no catalogue requests. gate.digest is the digest the check printed (the report without its clock); check-report.json is regenerated by every gate run.
